name: pgvector
description: Open-source vector similarity search for Postgres
readme: exact and approximate nearest neighbor search single-precision, half-precision, binary, and sparse vectors L2 distance, inner product, cosine distance, L1 distance, Hamming distance, and Jaccard distance any language with a Postgres client Plus ACID compliance, point-in-time recovery, JOINs, and all of the other great features of Postgres
